anomalies.description: A dense crowd surrounds and appears to confront individuals in high-visibility green jackets (likely police or security) on a city street; movement is chaotic, with people pressing in and some apparent physical contact or shoving near the green-jacketed figures.; After a brief separation, the crowd and green-jacketed individuals re-engage across the street; multiple people are seen running, scattering, and moving rapidly in disorganized fashion, consistent with ongoing unrest or dispersal under pressure.

A person in dark clothing is on the ground while another individual in a dark jacket with a white patch leans over and appears to strike or press down on them; the victim shows no active resistance, suggesting helplessness.

Two individuals engage in close physical struggle: one wearing a striped shirt appears to grab or strike another person in dark clothing; visible arm movements, contact, and body tension suggest mutual combat.

After the initial struggle, the person in the striped shirt appears to overpower and press down on the other individual, who is partially obscured and appears unable to resist—suggesting an asymmetrical attack on a less capable opponent.

Multiple individuals—including uniformed officers and civilians—are tightly clustered, with agitated gestures, shouting (visible open mouths), and rapid movement; context suggests escalation beyond isolated fighting into collective unrest.

Crowded, chaotic scene with multiple uniformed personnel and civilians in close proximity, shouting, and physical engagement; debris visible on ground (f12–f13), indicating collective unrest beyond isolated conflict.
Multiple individuals, including uniformed officers and civilians, are engaged in close physical struggle; arms are interlocked, bodies are pushed and pulled, consistent with mutual combat.

A person in a striped top appears restrained and on the ground while officers apply force; the individual is not actively resisting in later frames (f10–f12), suggesting a helpless victim being subdued.

Sustained chaotic crowd activity with multiple individuals in close proximity, some wearing uniforms (possibly police), and signs of confrontation (e.g., 'PAY NO' sign at f0, raised arms, pushing). The scene shows collective unrest rather than isolated incident, though visual clarity is low.
A person in a red shirt appears to strike or push a person in a blue jacket; physical contact is visible between them amid a crowd.
Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat: punching, grappling, and shoving in a dense crowd; visible throughout frames f1–f14 with escalating intensity and multiple participants.

A person in light-colored shirt is on the ground (f4–f11) while others stand over and strike or push them; the victim appears unable to effectively defend themselves, indicating targeted attack on a helpless individual.

Large group of people engaged in chaotic, violent collective behavior including pushing, striking, and falling; scene shows loss of order and widespread aggression beyond isolated fights, consistent with riot conditions.
